title: Tech Note: Manage 4D Mobile sessions with $info parameter in V17

historical_commentary.text: 4D Mobile as a distinct branded product line (paired with the Wakanda-based mobile generation tooling) was discontinued; the underlying REST session-management mechanics described here (listing/ending sessions via REST calls, admin vs client sessions) persist conceptually in 4D's ORDA/REST server session model, but the specific '4D Mobile' UI and workflow shown is obsolete.
related_updates: 4D Mobile app generation and Wakanda-based tooling were discontinued
modern 4D REST/ORDA server exposes session and force-login management through different, actively maintained APIs
Qodly Studio and responsive ORDA/REST web apps are 4D's current mobile-facing approach
